skill.summary: Scrapes competitor SaaS pricing and user feedback to model optimal tiers, detect gaps, and generate pricing pages and announcement videos in 10 minutes.

latestVersion.changelog:
v1.0.0 — Initial release: Automates SaaS pricing intelligence through competitor data scraping, user sentiment mining, and pricing recommendation.

- Scrapes competitor pricing pages, along with G2 reviews and Reddit threads, to create a complete pricing landscape.
- Detects pricing gaps and underserved tiers using real willingness-to-pay signals from users.
- Models optimal pricing strategy and packaging, tailored for SaaS founders and product teams.
- Automatically generates complete pricing page copy and a video announcement with InVideo AI.
- Integrates Apify for data collection and Claude AI for strategic recommendations.
